title: mcteunofficial
description: MCTEU is an unofficial version of mcte created by ngt5479. It has features such as block copying and miniature creation.
body:
MCTEUnofficial is an unofficial version of MCTE created by ngt5479.

This mod adds a variety of powerful world editing and miniature building tools to Minecraft, allowing players to quickly edit vast areas and easily create detailed structures.

Using the editor tools, players can:

Select and edit areas

Copy and paste structures

Fill areas with specific blocks

Randomly fill selected areas with multiple block types

Efficiently perform advanced world editing operations

This mod also includes a miniature block system, which can be used to perform the following operations on selected areas:

Shrink to miniature structures

Rotate freely without the limitations of normal block placement

Use for detailed decorations and compact structures

MCTEUnofficial is designed for architects, map creators, and players who want more advanced building tools than those in vanilla Minecraft.

It is especially useful when building large-scale structures or when you want to use the miniature features to pay attention to detail.

Credits

MCTEUnofficial is based on MCTE originally created by ngt5479.

This project is distributed with permission from the original creator.
